assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:roxy@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Roxy bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.6) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15; the model routes its observations to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, actor delivery or reception material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's seventeen selectors MT-XM-ST01 to ST17: V01 employed teacher and departure, V02 palace exit and search decision, V04 search and port near miss, V05 village return, V06 Kishirika lead and split mission, V10 East Port guard duty (retrospective extra), V12 solitary survival, rescue, bereavement, conditional proposal and teaching post, V13 teaching and household boundaries, V14 exclusion from the castle and return welcome, and V15 working spouse, confirmed pregnancy, disclosure advocacy, rescue and the Eris misreading. Volumes in which she is offstage supply no state, no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established; no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-XM-001 to 006) for professional self-assessment under correction, response to gifted-pupil comparison, sustained search for missing family, resistance to threatening information, belonging through an inaccessible channel, and ordinary conversation, each with a countercase and a discriminating observation and with per-volume applicability notes through V15. It states that mechanism confidence is moderate, that all calibration is retrospective fitting with prior familiarity rather than a holdout, and that no domain is DOMAIN_READY; six compressed rules with chapter-number locators into an uncurated index do not support B. Explicit, falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Seventeen selectors run from the V01 village tutor to the V15 pregnant working spouse, each with a knowledge limit, and each rule carries a per-volume extension or an explicit no-new-trigger note (for example 003 extended to ST06 only for guard duty, 005 left UNTESTED after V05), with the rule that no earlier state acquires later knowledge. The selectors are one-line labels whose transitions are owned by the uncurated shared state ledger, and she is offstage between V06, V10 and V12, so B is not supported; a dated developmental sequence with knowledge limits per state exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes her written voice only in prose: often polite explanatory speech that can correct, object, tease or give evasive minimal replies, inward doubt differing from outward composure, contextual exuberance beside the polite default, and no universal meekness or fixed catchphrase (rule 006). It quotes no Japanese wording, self-reference, ending or address form and gives no register locus beyond chapter numbers, and it rates audiovisual speech INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, so D is not supported; the register is affirmatively characterized with countercases, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Located ordinary items include paid village work, route choice, frustration with companions, shared food, drink and reminiscence, a short family stay, sweet tastes and a newly enjoyed sweet drink (V06), the costs of convivial drinking and use of Talhand's funds, a recalled food aversion overcome to model conduct (V10), and household logistics during absences (V14). The model refuses a complete diet, calls ordinary adult peer scenes sparse and supplies each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

Rules condition responses on relation and state: pride versus objection to the master label depending on relationship state (002), reunion versus aid priorities toward missing family (003), the parents' inaccessible telepathy and the tear-and-embrace change (005), affection with criticism toward the predatory old colleague (006), the conditional proposal requiring Sylphie's agreement, touch limits and requested affection with Rudeus, the requirement that both wives be present for disclosure, conditional acceptance of Ruijerd through trust in Paul, exclusion by Perugius, and the misreading of Eris's willingness to teach. The relationship section is one paragraph and most contrasts are a clause in a rule cell, so B is not supported; relation-conditioned response ranges across many recipients and states exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model records that its direct evidence covers interiority: V06 direct focalized action, the V10 extra's focalized fear and its correction, V12 first-person survival goals and work, inward doubt against outward composure, and the V13 hat scene later described as first felt acceptance. Each is summarized in a clause without quoted or elaborated inner content, and the model abstains on clinical mechanisms, so C is not supported; located focalized episodes across several volumes exceed limited local self-report, so E is not supported.

Conflict responses are located within broader rules: exit from a harassing workplace, confrontation of a feared Ruijerd despite fear and later correction (V10), refusal of a temporary-lover arrangement (V12), resistance to a teaching request before agreeing (V13), spoken acceptance of a categorical racial exclusion under constraint (V14), and rejection of violent intervention in a professional problem (V15). There is no dedicated conflict rule, escalation is not modeled and each instance is a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located responses with countercases exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model locates morally costly choices: choosing family locations over a personal eye reward and returning toward Paul instead of a desired reunion (V06, test V06), helping a bereaved former pupil with mixed motives and then revising counsel (V12), conditioning a proposal on a spouse's agreement, and requiring both wives at a threat disclosure (V15). The weighing itself is not elaborated, the model says commitment is not pure motive or guaranteed efficiency and rates reliable search forecasting INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, so C is not supported; repeated located costly choices with countercases exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

The model names teasing once as part of her conversational range and mentions contextual exuberance and convivial drinking, but locates no humorous or playful instance and models no function for play. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: a compact model covering her V01-V15 appearances through six rules, seventeen selectors and twenty-nine retrospective checks, with all observations routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row. The series continues past V15 and the model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which she appears exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

Every rule has a countercase, and the model locates affirmative errors and limits: inability to copy every pupil technique (V01), the V04 missed identification, the invented return route and the assumption that Kishirika sails (V06), the misclassified Ruijerd (V10), the misestimated spell and the need for rescue after exhausted survival (V12), mana exhaustion and need for backup (V13), exclusion by Perugius after a concession (V14), and the misread willingness of Eris to teach (V15); it also rejects reading her appearance as a child age. Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located, witnessed errors and countercases exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and, in most rules, chapter numbers, with explicit knowledge limits (for example ST01 does not know the source of Rudy's fear, ST05 knows only a qualified Zenith lead) and the rule that no earlier state acquires later knowledge; historical revision notes are kept distinct from current applicability. B is not supported because selectors are volume-level one-line labels with transitions held by an uncurated state ledger and no in-world dates; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose (polite explanatory default, correction, objection, evasive replies, contextual exuberance) and quotes no wording, and it permits only near-analog reconstruction in named states with no generated scene supplying evidence. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a one-line register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register and its countercases.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-XM-ST01 to ST17 between V01 and V15, with that state's knowledge only; nothing after V15 and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as pupil, rescuer and later husband, her parents, Elinalise and Talhand as companions, Paul, Sylphie and Eris as household members, Norn, Ruijerd and Perugius within their located contacts.
setting_constraints: The named villages, palace, search routes, labyrinth, university and household of the Japanese light novels V01-V15
No modern setting, institution or technology outside the source
No unseen skill, diagnosis, romance outcome or future knowledge
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D1 near-analog reconstruction only in named states, rules out modern-setting personas and generated scenes as evidence, says no domain is DOMAIN_READY and requires abstention in unsupported contexts; its rules are compressed and calibrated retrospectively with prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (shared food and drink, reminiscence, a short family stay, household logistics), and the model calls ordinary adult peer scenes sparse and refuses a complete everyday life. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates outcomes of costly choices (search over reward, conditioned proposal, inclusion at disclosure) but summarizes rather than shows her weighing, and the model rates reliable search forecasting INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not elaborate; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

The model locates attraction before recognition, help offered with desire, refusal to be a temporary lover, a proposal conditioned on Sylphie's agreement, touch limits and a request for affection, but rates a general romantic persona INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and gives no romance rule. CONDITIONAL would build a romantic persona from located acts the model keeps bounded; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore those acts.

conditions: Only attested professional situations as near analogs: instruction with usable feedback, magical or tactical correction, expedition or escort planning, classroom responsibility and supervision.
Output is behavior described in prose; no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
Fallibility and resource limits are retained: no unseen skill, effortless mastery or infallible interpretation, and need for backup or rescue stays possible.
The selected state's knowledge only; no later knowledge in an earlier state.
scenario_readiness.note: Rule 001 has the model's widest observed range: adapting instruction, repairing mistakes, seeking paid work, tactical teaching, university teaching, plant expertise, field planning, supervision and finding a specialist, with competence and limits (need for rescue, mana exhaustion, misreading) located across V01-V15. Readiness is conditional because the model rates teaching and work self-assessment BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with moderate mechanism confidence and allows only near-analog use. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a professional procedure; NOT_READY would deny the most broadly located domain in the evidence.

known_limits.statement: Her youthful appearance is not evidence of a child age or global ineptitude; the model requires the source's adult history and work to govern.

Her expertise coexists with located errors and limits: missed identification, a wrong inferred route, a misclassified Ruijerd, a misestimated spell, exhausted survival needing rescue, mana exhaustion and a misreading of Eris; no infallible expert or effortless-genius history is established.
The family-reunion belonging rule rests on one V05 reunion with telepathy unchanged; later welcomes are near analogies only, and no permanent homecoming or cure of exclusion is established.

Attraction, a conditioned proposal, marriage, touch limits and requested affection are located acts; the model rates a general romantic persona INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and her idealized accounts and apprehensions remain her beliefs.
The voice evidence is a prose characterization of written speech with no quoted Japanese wording; audiovisual speech is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

All twenty-nine checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its chapter locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Nothing after V15 is in evidence; later states, knowledge and development are not assessed, and volumes where she is offstage supply no state.
No humorous or playful instance is located, so humor and play are not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence that she lacks humor.
